text:
violet: I opened a small PR to tighten wording and add ops-ready examples for Dedicated provisioning + autoscale v2. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6809. Would love an infra + legal quick pass.

samir: quick skim. nice to see a compact migration checklist. two quick asks: 1) include a safe dry-run to detect `owner` labels, and 2) show a curl example that creates a fallback routing policy to a quantized model.

violet: added both. dry-run example uses jq and prints counts. pasted here:

```bash
# dry-run: count reservations by label key
redwood-cli reservations list --format json \
  | jq -r '.[] | .labels.owner // empty' \
  | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr
```

olga: legal: re SLA sentence please. avoid words like "may" without context. propose: "If Dedicated pool capacity cannot serve requests, Redwood will route traffic to compatible hosted model variants; such reroutes are excluded from the Dedicated SLA unless the customer agreement explicitly includes them. Customers will receive console and webhook notifications when reroutes occur."

violet: updated to that exact wording. thanks.

infra-bot: deploy-preview built: https://deploy-preview-6809--docs.redwood.ai (2026-03-23T16:22:11Z) :white_check_mark:

samir: also noticed an API name mismatch: examples used `preemption_policy: best-effort` but infra renamed it to `allow-preempt`. can you align YAML + SDK snippets?

violet: fixed all occurrences to `allow-preempt` and added a short note about the enum change in the migration appendix.

olga: legal asks for one explicit example scenario in the docs so customers know what triggers a reroute. suggest one bullet: "If a Dedicated reservation is saturated for >2 minutes and autoscale cannot provision additional capacity, traffic may be routed to an available hosted quantized variant; an incident will be recorded and customers notified."

violet: added that bullet under the SLA section.

samir: small ops nit: include a recommended safe order of operations for label remap: snapshot -> dry-run -> staged remap (canary reservations) -> full remap. ops prefers explicit steps.

violet: added a 4-step remap plan and a sample canary jq filter.

```bash
# canary: select 5 reservations to test remap
redwood-cli reservations list --format json \
  | jq -c '.[] | select(.labels.owner != null) | .id' \
  | head -n5 | xargs -I{} redwood-cli reservations update {} --patch '{"labels":{"team": .labels.owner}}'
```

infra-bot: small warning in preview: the YAML code fence on the isolation example lost leading spaces on the preemption_policy field. appears to be a markdown parser edge-case.

violet: thanks, fixed fences and rerendered preview.

docs-bot: PR merged by violet into main (commit 4d2f7ab) - publish queued.

samir: LGTM. please add a short release-note blurb that mentions: cooldown default change (60->120s), label normalization (`owner`->`team`), and API enum rename for preemption policy. ops will circulate the runbook.

violet: added release-note items and a pointer to /handbook/ops/remap-playbook. merging now. closing thread.
